description: This PHP source file defines a class for the HTMLPurifier library that manages the scripting module, which includes 'script' and 'noscript' elements and their associated properties and behaviors. It is part of an HTML sanitization system, focusing on handling scripting content with attention to safety implications.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Scripting
classes.description: Defines the scripting capabilities within the HTMLPurifier library, managing scripting elements, their attributes, and content models for secure HTML sanitization.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the scripting module, defining attribute and content models for 'script' and 'noscript' elements, enabling customization and enforcement of security policies regarding scripting content.
